opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grant

amount.raw: Scheme A up to £200; Scheme B up to £500 (Adelphi co-sponsored up to £750); Scheme C up to £300

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society 'junior scientist' members. Scheme A open to undergraduate, Master's and PhD students and postdocs within six years of PhD viva. Schemes B & C open to PhD students and postdocs within six years of PhD viva (not undergrad/Masters).
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance of Genetics Society junior scientist members at conferences on research in Genetics, with three streams: (A) Genetics Society/SIG meetings, (B) non-Genetics Society meetings, (C) virtual conferences. Applicants must present a poster or give a talk.

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society studying or working in the UK, or attending a course held in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others should be members for at least one year.
opportunities.summary: Enables members to attend formal short genetics-related training courses, or a collaborative visit to another laboratory to train in specific genetic/genomic techniques. Covers travel, accommodation, subsistence and registration/tuition fees.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society studying or working in the UK, or intending to carry out fieldwork in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others should be members for at least one year.
opportunities.summary: Funded by the journal Heredity, awards cover travel and accommodation costs associated with a field-based genetic research project whose results would typically be suitable for publication in Heredity.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.summary: Supports public engagement activities related to genetics, delivered in person or virtually. Funding covers eligible travel (UK-based, budget/economy) and materials costs.

opportunities.title: Carer's Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any member of the Genetics Society, regardless of age of the person they are caring for. Priority given to early-career scientists and by need.
opportunities.summary: Provides an award of up to £60/day to support members with caring responsibilities to attend a Society meeting or event, used as the recipient thinks best supports their attendance.

opportunities.title: One-off Meeting Grant

amount.raw: A specific lecture for a few hundred pounds; a session up to ~£1,000; major sponsorship typically £1,000-£2,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of the Genetics Society. Meetings should be based in, or have strong links with, the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of genetic-themed meetings not organised directly by the Genetics Society, used towards the organisation of a meeting (not attendance). Includes a Carer's Award component.

opportunities.title: Special Interest Group (SIG) Funding
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics research communities wishing to run regular series of themed meetings. Meetings should be based in, or have strong links with, the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of research meetings on particular themes for genetics research communities who wish to run a regular series of meetings (e.g. Seed Plant, e-ACGT, C. elegans Group).
